ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are four AND-gate-shaped logic gates with small output inversion circles, that is, four NAND gates. The two inputs of the upper-left NAND gate are D and C, and its output is connected to the right to one input of the upper middle NAND gate. The horizontal line of input B has a black connection point in the middle, branches upward to connect to the other input of the upper middle NAND gate, and at the same time B also continues to connect to the lower NAND gate; input A is connected to the other input of the lower NAND gate. The outputs of the upper middle NAND gate and the lower NAND gate are respectively connected into the final NAND gate on the far right, and the final output is labeled Q. Reasoning: Let the output of the upper-left NAND gate be X, then X = overline(CD). Let the output of the upper middle NAND gate be Y, then Y = overline(BX) = overline(B · overline(CD)). Let the output of the lower NAND gate be Z, then Z = overline(AB). The final NAND gate output Q = overline(YZ). Substituting Y and Z: Q = overline(overline(B · overline(CD)) · overline(AB)). By De Morgan's law, Q = B · overline(CD) + AB. Then expanding overline(CD) = overline(C) + overline(D), so Q = AB + B overline(C) + B overline(D).

raw_record.question_text: Consider the logic circuit shown in the image: \( Q = \) ______?

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure, then assign intermediate signals. Let X = overline(CD) from the top-left NAND. The upper middle NAND gives Y = overline(BX) = overline(B · overline(CD)). The lower NAND gives Z = overline(AB). The final NAND gives Q = overline(YZ). Substitute Y and Z: Q = overline(overline(B · overline(CD)) · overline(AB)) = B · overline(CD) + AB. Finally expand overline(CD) as Cbar + Dbar to obtain Q = AB + B Cbar + B Dbar.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有四个带输出反相小圆点的与门形状逻辑门，即四个 NAND 门。左上 NAND 门的两个输入为 D 和 C，其输出向右接到上方中间 NAND 门的一个输入。输入 B 的水平线在中间有一个黑色连接点，向上分支接到上方中间 NAND 门的另一个输入，同时 B 也继续接到下方 NAND 门；输入 A 接到下方 NAND 门的另一个输入。上方中间 NAND 门和下方 NAND 门的输出分别接入最右侧最终 NAND 门，最终输出标为 Q。

推理：设左上 NAND 门输出为 X，则 X = overline(CD)。上方中间 NAND 门输出为 Y，则 Y = overline(BX) = overline(B · overline(CD))。下方 NAND 门输出为 Z，则 Z = overline(AB)。最终 NAND 门输出 Q = overline(YZ)。代入 Y 和 Z：Q = overline(overline(B · overline(CD)) · overline(AB))。由德摩根律可得 Q = B · overline(CD) + AB。再展开 overline(CD) = overline(C) + overline(D)，所以 Q = AB + B overline(C) + B overline(D)。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the NAND rule output = complement of the AND of its inputs, then apply De Morgan’s law and absorption/distribution to simplify: NAND(x,y)=overline(xy), overline(overline X · overline Y)=X+Y, and overline(CD)=Cbar+Dbar.
